name: campus-portal-ai-backend
description: Secure backend for the AI Powered Campus Placement Portal. Keeps the LLM API key server-side (/api/ai, /api/ai/stream) AND now owns a Postgres-backed persistence layer for user accounts, JWT auth, and saved quiz/interview/roadmap/radar/resume-analysis results (/api/auth/*, /api/results/*).
